text:
casey: Kicking off the changelog + release-note draft for the docs deploy. Goals: finalize bullets, standardize SDK snippets, add migration note for Dedicated routing v2, and a Known Issue for embeddings streaming. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5201

mei: I'll run a full linkcheck (including legacy-redirects.yaml) and open redirect PRs for any renamed anchors. Please drop files that need snippet changes in the PR description.

oshin: Noted divergence: some pages still use legacy client patterns (`Client(...)` / `client.generate(...)`). I'll batch-rewrite to `const client = new RedwoodClient(...)` + `await client.responses.create(...)`, include try/catch in network examples.

leo: Known Issue to include: "Embeddings streaming may intermittently 403 on long multi-chunk uploads. Workaround: set batch_size=1 and enable prefix_cache; avoid parallel chunk uploads in the same session." Attached internal eval: EVAL-2024-10-22.

intl-bot: intl-checker flagged placeholder normalization issues in fr/zh for code blocks: tickets INTL-1155, INTL-1156 created.

casey: Copy freeze target for localization: 2024-09-30 23:59 UTC. Publish target: 2024-10-12 16:00 PT. Oshin, put the exact file list into the PR body so translators can preview before cutoff.

mei: I'll open small redirect PRs and list them in the relnotes PR. Planning to merge redirects early to avoid 404s in the published relnotes.

oshin: Pushed the snippet parity commit to the relnotes branch; replaced constructors and updated JS + Python examples. Also added a short migration blurb for Dedicated: "Routing policy v2 prefers lower-latency regional fallbacks. Customers pinning models should re-verify rollouts post-upgrade."

docs-bot: docs-ci passed for PR #5201 and redirect PRs.

casey: Thanks team — once intl thumbs-up is in I'll do a final sweep and cut the release branch. :ship:
